def remove_Occ(s, ch):
    first = s.find(ch)
    if first == -1:
        return s

    last = s.rfind(ch)
    if first == last:
        return s[:first] + s[first + 1:]

    return s[:first] + s[first + 1:last] + s[last + 1:]

assert remove_Occ("hello", "l") == "heo"
assert remove_Occ("banana", "a") == "bnan"
assert remove_Occ("abc", "x") == "abc"
assert remove_Occ("a", "a") == ""
assert remove_Occ("lll", "l") == "l"
print("all tests passed")

def check(n):
    rev = int(str(n)[::-1])
    return n == 2 * rev - 1

print(check(70))
print(check(13))
print(check(0))

def tetrahedral_number(n):
    return n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) // 6

    return 3 * n * (n - 1) + 1
